content: macOS FSEvents may batch, reorder, miss, or over-deliver events; provides no old/new path association for renames (only ItemRenamed flag at both paths). Editor atomic saves (VS Code, vim) produce Create(temp)+Rename+Write = 3+ events per logical save; notify-debouncer-full rewrites paths for pre-rename events. Events sometimes not delivered until file close (notify#240). Reconciliation scan is mandatory, debounce alone insufficient.
